newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products lower across the board.

text.p: NWE oil products were all weaker on Thursday.

Naphtha ended slighlty lower under the weight of ample prompt supply and views that traders will try and keep prices down until they have to price their cargoes that are loading out of Algeria for the Far East.
Gasoline was steady to lower in thin trade.
High sulphur fuel oil was weaker as a cargo traded at $85 cif U.K.
Gas oil premiums combined with easier IPE futures to knock up to $3 off outright values.
